title: CockroachDB's Debezium connector drops the commit time
symptom: source.ts_hlc is null; ts_ns and ts_ms hold the connector's offset time, the same for changes committed apart
cause: The connector reads only the schema and table names from the changefeed's source block
effect: Silver can't sequence by the database's commit time
fix: Sequence by the event's top-level ts_ns (one server processes a key's changes in order)
